"distributed training, edge inference, or on-device ML": only distributed-training maps to the taxonomy, so there is no group.

No inference-optimization or containerization-style parents are added; the posting does not name them.

I took the highest level named (PhD), which comes from the optional section, so degree_requirement is nice_to_have. The alternative reading is bachelor/required. Flagged for review.
